chapters.label: Porto Alegre
chapters.text: World Cup 2014, Porto Alegre, nil-nil. Germany in white push up high. Algeria in green go long, and Slimani chases... but Manuel Neuer races out of his box and heads it away!

chapters.label: Read it early
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Neuer reads the ball over the top the moment it's kicked, and he's off before it bounces.

chapters.label: First to it
chapters.text: Outside his box he can't use his hands, so he heads it, a split second before Slimani, out for a throw-in.

chapters.label: Sweeper keeper
chapters.text: Read the through ball early, and a keeper can sweep up behind the defence.
